decks.name: LeetCode #143 - Reorder List
decks.description: Reorder a linked list in alternating first-last pattern in-place

cards.question: Reorder List: You are given the head of a singly linked-list. The list can be represented as: L0 → L1 → … → Ln - 1 → Ln. Reorder the list to be on the following form: L0 → Ln → L1 → Ln - 1 → L2 → Ln - 2 → … You may not modify the values in the list's nodes. Only nodes themselves may be changed.

solutions.name: Reverse And Merge
solutions.explanation: Find the middle of the list using slow-fast pointers, reverse the second half, then merge both halves alternately. Most efficient with O(1) space complexity using three-step approach: find middle, reverse second half, merge.
